title: Explorer: clip.root (and other appended options) land inside a trailing # comment, so the fix is silently a no-op
description: Seen in renders/explore/cycle2-bright: the op {clip.root low G1} rewrote 'clip low = ...Ave_34409.mp3  hold-4  root Ab1  # a clean low note...' as '... hold-4  # a clean low note: ... (the checker heard it)  root G1'. It dropped the existing root Ab1 and put the new option after '#', so every stage-2 'fix' measured something other than it claims (the pin was lost, not moved to G1). Fix: edit options before any trailing comment (or via the parser/formatter), replace an existing option rather than append, and add a test with a commented line. Re-check any accepted clip.root/edit results from earlier runs.
